name: Neh-Thalggu Hivemaster
body:
NEH-THALGGU HIVEMASTER
CR 13

This crab-like nightmare has a lamprey mouth, twitching eyes on its legs, and several blisters along its back that hold human brains.

XP 25,600
Neh-thalggu mesmerist 9
NE Large aberration
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +24

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 19, flat-footed 18 (+3 Dex, +7 insight, +2 natural, –1 size)
hp 189 (19d8+104)
Fort +13, Ref +12, Will +21
DR 10/magic; Immune confusion; SR 19

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft. (perfect)
Melee bite +18 (1d8+6), 2 claws +18 (1d6+6)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks bold stares (disorientation, sapped magic), hypnotic stare (–3), manifold tricks (3 tricks), mental potency (+1), mesmerist tricks 9/day (astounding avoidance, fleet in shadows, misdirection, see in darkness, spectral smoke), painful stare (+4 or +3d6), poison, rend (2 claws, 2d6+9)
Mesmerist Spells Known (CL 9th; concentration +21)

3rd (4/day)—confusion (DC 18), haunting choir (DC 18), terrible remorse (DC 18), vampiric touch
2nd (5/day)—babble (DC 17), burning gaze (DC 17), howling agony (DC 17), touch of idiocy
1st (7/day)—comprehend languages, fumbletongue (DC 16), hideous laughter (DC 16), ray of enfeeblement (DC 16), unseen servant
0th (at will)—dancing lights, detect magic, detect psychic significance, lullaby (DC 15), prestidigitation, unwitting ally (DC 15)

Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 7th; concentration +19)

3rd (5/day)—displacement, gaseous form
2nd (7/day)—blur, eagle’s splendor, mirror image
1st (8/day)—grease, magic missile, memory lapse (DC 16), obscuring mist, shocking grasp
0th (at will)—bleed (DC 15), jolt, light, mage hand, message, read magic, touch of fatigue (DC 15)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 16, Con 21, Int 21, Wis 17, Cha 20
Base Atk +13; CMB +20; CMD 40 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Arcane Strike, Combat Reflexes, Critical Focus, Demoralizing Stare, Elongated Cranium, Eschew MaterialsB, Extend Spell, Great Fortitude, Impaling Critical, Improved Initiative, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +3 (–5 to jump), Appraise +10, Bluff +33, Diplomacy +29, Disguise +7, Fly +15, Heal +2, Intimidate +29, Knowledge (arcana) +33, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +23, Knowledge (planes) +33, Linguistics +9, Perception +24, Sense Motive +24, Spellcraft +26, Stealth +12, Survival +2, Use Magic Device +20
Languages Abyssal, Aklo, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Protean, Undercommon; telepathy 100 ft.
SQ brain collection, consummate liar +4, touch treatment 8/day (Moderate)

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or hive (1 hivemaster plus 2–4 neh-thalggus)
Treasure standard

Neh-thalggu hivemasters lord it over their lesser kin by applying the drained brainpower of their victims toward mastering psychic magic, most often by following the path of the mesmerist. They may inhabit elaborate mindscapes as their lairs or may subtly influence the thoughts and senses of creatures they lure into their lair in furtherance of convoluted plots to manipulate the societies around them while they dwell in secret.
